Springfield Bicycle Club Group Rides

Springfield, IL · Road · Gravel · Mountain bike

Beginner friendly

Springfield Bicycle Club Group Rides is a road, gravel and mountain bike group ride in Springfield, IL. Schedule: Group rides most days of the week, April through October. See the club's Google calendar. Pace: pace groups from EZ (under 10 mph, no-drop) to A (18–20+ mph).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @springfieldbicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Springfield Bicycle Club Group Rides group ride

A 380-member club in central Illinois with rides almost every day in season. Rides are sorted by pace, from EZ social rides where nobody is dropped up to fast A rides. D rides are for novices and have a sweep. There are gravel and mountain bike rides too. Times and start points are on the club's Google calendar.
